"""Prepared GPU core ablations. CPU CSR/grouping is not hidden in GPU timing."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import os
import sys
import torch

HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BASE=HERE.parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(BASE))
from metadata import build_plan,validate_plan
from planning import group_tasks,CHUNKS

VARIANTS={"control":-1,"private_sO":0,"resident4":1,"resident8":2,
          "resident16":3,"folded_V":4,"folded_resident8":5,
          "folded_resident16":6,"early_folded_resident8":7}
_OPS=None


def load_extension():
    global _OPS
    if _OPS is None:
        from torch.utils.cpp_extension import load
        build=HERE/"build";build.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        (build/"ptx").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        os.environ.setdefault("MAX_JOBS","2")
        load(name="xomtention_kvopt4",sources=[str(HERE/"wrapper.cpp"),
             str(HERE/"resident_kernel.cu"),str(HERE/"gpu_metadata.cu"),str(BASE/"optimization_round3/row_kernel.cu"),
             str(BASE/"optimization_round1/combine_warp.cu")],build_directory=str(build),
             extra_cflags=["-O2"],extra_cuda_cflags=["-O2","-lineinfo","--ptxas-options=-v",
                 "--keep","--keep-dir",str(build/"ptx"),"-gencode=arch=compute_100a,code=sm_100a"],
             extra_ldflags=["-lcuda"],is_python_module=False,verbose=True)
        _OPS=torch.ops.xomtention_kvopt4
    return _OPS


class Workspace:
    def __init__(self,q,k,selected,plan=None):
        self.plan=plan or build_plan(selected,k.shape[2]//128,q.shape[1]//k.shape[1])
        validate_plan(self.plan,selected)
        p=self.plan
        if (p.batch,p.hkv,p.sq,p.group_size)!=(q.shape[0],k.shape[1],q.shape[2],q.shape[1]//k.shape[1]):
            raise ValueError("plan/QKV shape mismatch")
        self.qshape=tuple(q.shape);self.device=q.device
        self.qids=p.query_ids.to(q.device);self.ranks=p.ranks.to(q.device)
        self.partial=torch.empty((*q.shape[:-1],16,128),device=q.device,dtype=torch.float32)
        self.lses=torch.empty((*q.shape[:-1],16),device=q.device,dtype=torch.float32)
        self.out=torch.empty_like(q)
        self.out_lse=torch.empty(q.shape[:-1],device=q.device,dtype=torch.float32)


class Prepared:
    def __init__(self,q,k,v,selected,*,variant=-1,plan=None,workspace=None):
        if variant not in CHUNKS:raise ValueError("unknown variant")
        self.ops=load_extension();self.q,self.k,self.v=q,k,v;self.variant=variant
        self.workspace=workspace or Workspace(q,k,selected,plan)
        w=self.workspace
        if w.qshape!=tuple(q.shape) or w.device!=q.device:raise ValueError("workspace shape/device")
        self.plan=w.plan
        self.tasks_cpu=group_tasks(self.plan,variant);self.tasks=self.tasks_cpu.to(q.device)
        self.qids,self.ranks=w.qids,w.ranks
        self.partial,self.lses,self.out,self.out_lse=w.partial,w.lses,w.out,w.out_lse

    def poison(self):
        for t in (self.partial,self.lses,self.out,self.out_lse):t.fill_(float("nan"))

    def main(self):
        self.ops.main_out(self.q,self.k,self.v,self.tasks,self.qids,self.ranks,
                          self.partial,self.lses,self.variant)

    def combine(self):
        self.ops.combine_out(self.partial,self.lses,self.out,self.out_lse)

    def run(self):
        self.main();self.combine()


def correctness_adapter(variant,diffs):
    def attention(q,k,v,selected,plan=None,return_debug=False):
        p=Prepared(q,k,v,selected,variant=variant,plan=plan)
        p.poison();p.run()
        if variant!=-1:
            c=Prepared(q,k,v,selected,variant=-1,plan=p.plan)
            c.poison();c.run()
            record={"partial_equal":torch.equal(p.partial,c.partial),
                    "partial_lse_equal":torch.equal(p.lses,c.lses),
                    "output_equal":torch.equal(p.out,c.out),
                    "output_lse_equal":torch.equal(p.out_lse,c.out_lse)}
            record["partial_max_abs"]=float((p.partial-c.partial).abs().max())
            record["partial_lse_max_abs"]=float((p.lses-c.lses).abs().max())
            diffs.append(record)
            if not all(record[key] for key in ("partial_equal","partial_lse_equal","output_equal","output_lse_equal")):
                raise AssertionError(f"strict round3 equivalence failed: {record}")
        return (p.out,p.out_lse,p.partial,p.lses) if return_debug else p.out
    return attention


class ControlCombine:
    def combine(self,partial,lses):
        out=torch.empty((*partial.shape[:3],128),device=partial.device,dtype=torch.bfloat16)
        lse=torch.empty(partial.shape[:3],device=partial.device,dtype=torch.float32)
        load_extension().combine_out(partial,lses,out,lse)
        return out,lse


def source_evidence():
    paths=[BASE/name for name in ("primitives.cuh","metadata.py","reference.py","api.py","validate_gpu.py",
                                "optimization_round3/row_kernel.cu","optimization_round1/combine_warp.cu")]
    paths.extend(p for p in HERE.iterdir() if p.suffix in (".py",".cu",".cpp",".cuh"))
    sources={str(p.relative_to(BASE)):p.read_text() for p in sorted(paths)}
    return {"source_text":sources,"source_hashes":{name:hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest() for name,s in sources.items()}}

"""Round7: where does rawmax8's time go? Two independent answers in one GPU call.

1. Subtractive attribution: diagnostic builds of rawmax8 with one component
   removed, timed with the round4 protocol (harness fix in timing7.py).
2. Nsight Compute `--set full` on rawmax8 main and Combine, if the container
   grants performance-counter access; otherwise the failure is recorded and
   the attribution still stands. No new correctness candidate exists here.
"""
import argparse
import gc
import glob
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import torch
from api7 import HERE,BASE,VARIANTS,DIAGNOSTIC,Prepared,load_extension,source_evidence
from metadata import make_selected
from timing7 import graph_timings

CURRENT={"passed":False,"cases":[],"profile":{}}
PROFILE_SHAPE=(2,1,16,4096,4096,"independent",5501)   # 1 GiB of partials: cheap kernel replay


def gpu_state():
    cmd=["nvidia-smi","--query-gpu=name,uuid,driver_version,temperature.gpu,power.draw,clocks.current.sm,clocks.current.memory","--format=csv,noheader"]
    return subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.strip()


def exact(a,b):
    torch.testing.assert_close(a,b,atol=0,rtol=0)


def attribution_case(spec):
    name,b,hkv,g,sq,skv,pattern,seed=spec
    print("CASE "+str(spec),flush=True)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    q=torch.randn((b,hkv*g,sq,128),device="cuda",dtype=torch.bfloat16)
    k=torch.randn((b,hkv,skv,128),device="cuda",dtype=torch.bfloat16);v=torch.randn_like(k)
    ids=make_selected(b,hkv,sq,skv//128,pattern,seed);live=ids.to(q.device)
    parent=Prepared(q,k,v,live,VARIANTS["overlap8"]);parent.poison();parent.run()
    ref=Prepared(q,k,v,live,VARIANTS["rawmax8"],parent);ref.poison();ref.run();torch.cuda.synchronize()
    audit=ref.plan.audit(ids)
    if not torch.isfinite(ref.partial).all().item() or not torch.isfinite(ref.lses).all().item():
        raise AssertionError("rawmax8 left unwritten partials")
    snapshot=(ref.out.clone(),ref.out_lse.clone(),ref.partial.clone(),ref.lses.clone())
    parent.poison();parent.run();exact(parent.out,snapshot[0]);exact(parent.out_lse,snapshot[1])
    exact(parent.partial,snapshot[2]);exact(parent.lses,snapshot[3])
    diag0=Prepared(q,k,v,live,VARIANTS["diag0"],parent);diag0.poison();diag0.run()
    exact(diag0.partial,snapshot[2]);exact(diag0.lses,snapshot[3]);exact(diag0.out,snapshot[0])
    checks={"rawmax8_equals_overlap8":True,"diag0_equals_rawmax8":True,"audit":audit}
    functions,before={},{}
    functions["overlap8/main"]=parent.main;before["overlap8/main"]=parent.metadata
    for stage,fn in (("main",ref.main),("core",ref.core),("operator",ref.run)):
        functions["rawmax8/"+stage]=fn
        if stage!="operator":before["rawmax8/"+stage]=ref.metadata
    prepared={}
    for label,variant in VARIANTS.items():
        if variant<100 or label=="diag0":continue
        p=Prepared(q,k,v,live,variant,parent);prepared[label]=p
        p.run();torch.cuda.synchronize()    # routes built; garbage partials by design
        functions[label+"/main"]=p.main;before[label+"/main"]=p.metadata
    functions["diag0/main"]=diag0.main;before["diag0/main"]=diag0.metadata
    functions["shared/combine"]=parent.combine;before["shared/combine"]=ref.run
    functions["control/metadata"]=parent.metadata
    state=gpu_state()
    timing=graph_timings(functions,before,rounds=5,target_ms=100,warmup_ms=150,settle_ms=60,
                         trailing=("shared/combine","control/metadata"))
    ref.poison();ref.run();exact(ref.out,snapshot[0]);exact(ref.out_lse,snapshot[1])
    flops=4*b*hkv*g*sq*16*128*128
    for key,m in timing["measurements"].items():
        if key.endswith(("/core","/operator")):m["useful_sparse_tflops"]=flops/(m["median_ms"]*1e9)
    partial_bytes=b*hkv*g*sq*16*128*4;q_gather_bytes=b*hkv*g*sq*16*128*2
    record={"name":name,"shape":{"B":b,"Hq":hkv*g,"Hkv":hkv,"Sq":sq,"Skv":skv,"D":128,"TopK":16},
            "seed":seed,"pattern":pattern,"dtype":"BF16","partial_dtype":"FP32",
            "selected_sha256":hashlib.sha256(ids.numpy().tobytes()).hexdigest(),
            "validation":checks,"timings":timing,"useful_qk_pv_flops":flops,
            "bytes":{"partial_o_fp32":partial_bytes,"partial_lse":partial_bytes//128,
                     "q_gather_bf16":q_gather_bytes,"kv_bf16":2*b*hkv*skv*128*2},
            "gpu_before":state,"gpu_after":gpu_state(),
            "diagnostic_note":"*/main of diagnostic variants produce garbage partials; only their time is meaningful"}
    print("SUMMARY "+json.dumps({k:round(m["median_ms"],6) for k,m in timing["measurements"].items()}),flush=True)
    return record


def find_ncu():
    found=shutil.which("ncu")
    if found:return found
    for pattern in ("/usr/local/cuda/bin/ncu","/opt/nvidia/nsight-compute/*/ncu","/usr/local/cuda-*/bin/ncu"):
        hits=sorted(glob.glob(pattern))
        if hits:return hits[-1]
    return None


def profile_target():
    """Child process under ncu: two warm runs, then the profiled run."""
    b,hkv,g,sq,skv,pattern,seed=PROFILE_SHAPE
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    q=torch.randn((b,hkv*g,sq,128),device="cuda",dtype=torch.bfloat16)
    k=torch.randn((b,hkv,skv,128),device="cuda",dtype=torch.bfloat16);v=torch.randn_like(k)
    live=make_selected(b,hkv,sq,skv//128,pattern,seed).to(q.device)
    p=Prepared(q,k,v,live,VARIANTS["rawmax8"])
    for _ in range(2):p.run()
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    p.run();torch.cuda.synchronize()
    print("PROFILE_TARGET_DONE",flush=True)


def profile(budget_seconds):
    ncu=find_ncu()
    result={"tool":ncu,"shape":PROFILE_SHAPE,"variant":"rawmax8","kernels":"main_kernel, kv_combine_warp"}
    if ncu is None:
        result["error"]="ncu not found in image";print("NCU missing",flush=True);return result
    report=str(HERE/"build"/"rawmax8_profile")
    command=[ncu,"--target-processes","all","--kernel-name-base","demangled",
             "-k","regex:main_kernel|kv_combine_warp","--launch-skip","4","--launch-count","2",
             "--set","full","--import-source","no","-f","-o",report,
             sys.executable,"-B",str(HERE/"benchmark7.py"),"--profile-target"]
    result["command"]=command
    # Profiling gets at most 240 s and leaves 90 s for the CSV dumps; the
    # remote function keeps timeout=8*60 whatever happens here.
    started=time.monotonic();limit=max(30,min(240,budget_seconds-90))
    try:
        run=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=limit)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
        result["error"]="ncu timed out after "+str(limit)+" s";print(result["error"],flush=True);return result
    result.update(returncode=run.returncode,stdout=run.stdout[-20000:],stderr=run.stderr[-20000:],
                  profile_seconds=time.monotonic()-started)
    print("NCU returncode="+str(run.returncode),flush=True)
    if run.returncode or not Path(report+".ncu-rep").exists():
        result["error"]="ncu failed (see stderr; ERR_NVGPUCTRPERM means no counter access)"
        print(run.stderr[-3000:],flush=True);return result
    for page in ("details","raw"):
        try:
            dump=subprocess.run([ncu,"-i",report+".ncu-rep","--csv","--page",page],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=40)
            result["csv_"+page]=dump.stdout;result["csv_"+page+"_stderr"]=dump.stderr[-4000:]
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            result["csv_"+page+"_error"]="dump timed out";break
    if "csv_details" not in result:return result
    lines=[l for l in result["csv_details"].splitlines() if any(t in l for t in
           ('"Duration"','"Memory Throughput"','"DRAM Throughput"','"Compute (SM) Throughput"',
            '"Achieved Occupancy"','"Registers Per Thread"','"L2 Hit Rate"','"Issue Slots Busy"'))]
    for l in lines[:40]:print("NCU "+l,flush=True)
    result["ok"]=True
    return result


def artifacts():
    binary=HERE/"build/xomtention_kvopt7.so"
    result={"resources":subprocess.run(["cuobjdump","--dump-resource-usage",str(binary)],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=30).stdout}
    sass=subprocess.run(["cuobjdump","--dump-sass",str(binary)],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=60).stdout
    parts=re.split(r'\n\s*Function : (\S+)\n',sass);histogram={}
    for i in range(1,len(parts),2):
        name,body=parts[i],parts[i+1]
        if "main_kernel" not in name and "kv_combine_warp" not in name:continue
        ops=re.findall(r'/\*[0-9a-f]{4,}\*/\s+(?:@!?U?P\d\s+)?([A-Z][A-Z0-9_.]*)',body)
        counts={}
        for op in ops:counts[op]=counts.get(op,0)+1
        histogram[name]={"instructions":len(ops),"opcodes":dict(sorted(counts.items(),key=lambda kv:-kv[1]))}
    result["sass_opcode_histogram"]=histogram
    return result


def run(mode):
    started=time.monotonic();torch.set_num_threads(1)
    torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32=False;torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32=False
    torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("highest")
    load_extension();CURRENT.update(mode=mode,device=torch.cuda.get_device_name(),torch=str(torch.__version__),cuda=torch.version.cuda)
    CURRENT["variants"]=VARIANTS
    for spec in (("large_g16",8,1,16,4096,4096,"independent",5501),("q8k",1,1,16,8192,8192,"independent",5505)):
        if time.monotonic()-started>300:raise RuntimeError("split remaining attribution, never raise timeout")
        CURRENT["cases"].append(attribution_case(spec))
        gc.collect();torch.cuda.empty_cache()
    remaining=440-(time.monotonic()-started)
    CURRENT["profile"]=profile(remaining) if remaining>150 else {"error":"no budget left for ncu; split instead of raising timeout"}
    CURRENT.update(artifacts());CURRENT.update(source_evidence())
    CURRENT.update(passed=True,elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-started)
    return CURRENT


if __name__=="__main__":
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument("--profile-target",action="store_true");args=parser.parse_args()
    if args.profile_target:
        torch.set_num_threads(1);load_extension();profile_target()

"""Conservative round7: one profiling/attribution call; one corrective spare at most."""
import ast
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import modal

REMOTE_BASE=Path("/kv_centric");REMOTE=REMOTE_BASE/"optimization_round7"
HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent if modal.is_local() else REMOTE
BASE=HERE.parent
BASE_FILES=("primitives.cuh","metadata.py","reference.py","api.py","validate_gpu.py",
            "optimization_round4/bench_api4.py","optimization_round4/gpu_plan.py",
            "optimization_round4/planning.py","optimization_round4/timing.py",
            "optimization_round4/gpu_metadata.cu",
            "optimization_round5/pipeline_kernel.cu",
            "optimization_round6/pipeline6_kernel.cu",
            "optimization_round1/combine_warp.cu")
NEW_FILES=("api7.py","benchmark7.py","timing7.py","diag7_kernel.cu","wrapper7.cpp","modal_runner.py","test_local.py")
image=(modal.Image.from_registry("nvidia/cuda:13.0.2-cudnn-devel-ubuntu24.04",add_python="3.12")
       .entrypoint([]).uv_pip_install("torch==2.9.1",index_url="https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu130")
       .uv_pip_install("ninja","numpy").env({"PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE":"1","MAX_JOBS":"2"}))
for n in BASE_FILES:image=image.add_local_file(BASE/n,str(REMOTE_BASE/n))
for n in NEW_FILES:image=image.add_local_file(HERE/n,str(REMOTE/n))
CACHE=modal.Volume.from_name("xomtention-kv-round7-build",create_if_missing=True)
app=modal.App("xomtention-kv-centric-round7",image=image)


@app.function(gpu="B200",timeout=8 * 60,volumes={str(REMOTE/"build"):CACHE},max_containers=1)
def experiment(mode:str,provenance:dict):
    import os
    import sys
    import time
    import traceback
    os.chdir(REMOTE);sys.path.insert(0,str(REMOTE))
    started=time.monotonic()
    from api7 import source_evidence
    for name,digest in provenance["source_hashes"].items():
        if hashlib.sha256((REMOTE_BASE/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=digest:
            raise RuntimeError("source mount mismatch: "+name)
    import benchmark7
    try:result=benchmark7.run(mode)
    except Exception:
        result=dict(benchmark7.CURRENT)
        result.update(passed=False,error=traceback.format_exc())
        print(result["error"],flush=True)
    result.update(source_evidence());result["provenance"]=provenance
    result.update(remote_seconds=time.monotonic()-started,modal_app_id=app.app_id)
    CACHE.commit()
    return result


@app.local_entrypoint()
def main(run_id:int,mode:str="profile"):
    if not 1<=run_id<=2:raise ValueError("planned one GPU call, at most one corrective spare")
    if mode!="profile":raise ValueError("mode")
    for p in HERE.glob("*.py"):ast.parse(p.read_text(),filename=str(p))
    preserved=json.loads((HERE/"preserved_manifest.json").read_text())["sha256"]
    for n,digest in preserved.items():
        if hashlib.sha256((BASE.parent/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=digest:raise RuntimeError("preserved file changed: "+n)
    paths=[BASE/n for n in BASE_FILES]+[HERE/n for n in NEW_FILES]
    hashes={str(p.relative_to(BASE)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths}
    results=HERE/"results";results.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    ledger=results/f"run_{run_id:03d}_attempt.json"
    record={"status":"reserved","run_id":run_id,"mode":mode,"utc":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
    with ledger.open("x") as f:json.dump(record,f,indent=2)
    provenance={"source_hashes":hashes,"timeout_seconds":8*60,"mode":mode,
                "preserved_files":len(preserved),"run_id":run_id}
    try:
        call=experiment.spawn(mode,provenance)
        record.update(status="running",call_id=call.object_id)
        ledger.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+"\n")
        print("MODAL_CALL "+call.object_id+" ledger="+str(ledger),flush=True)
        result=call.get()
    except BaseException as error:
        record.update(status="client_interrupted_remote_state_unknown",error=repr(error))
        ledger.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+"\n");raise
    target=results/f"run_{run_id:03d}_{mode}.json"
    with target.open("x") as f:json.dump(result,f,indent=2)
    record.update(status="finished",passed=result["passed"],result_file=target.name)
    ledger.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+"\n")
    print("SAVED "+str(target)+" passed="+str(result["passed"]),flush=True)
    if not result["passed"]:raise RuntimeError("GPU run failed; inspect saved failure before next call")

"""Structural checks for round7; not a substitute for real CUDA execution."""
import ast
import hashlib
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path
import unittest

HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BASE=HERE.parent
R6=BASE/"optimization_round6"
GUARD_REMOVE=re.compile(r"^\s*if constexpr\(!\(DIAG&[A-Z|]+\)\) \{\s*$")
GUARD_SWAP=re.compile(r"^\s*if constexpr\(DIAG&NOEXP\) \{\s*$")
GUARD_ELSE=re.compile(r"^\s*\} else \{\s*$")
GUARD_CLOSE=re.compile(r"^\s*\} // DIAG\s*$")


def strip_guards(text):
    """DIAG==0 view: drop removal guards; keep only the else-branch of the swap guard."""
    out=[];skipping=False
    for l in text.splitlines():
        if GUARD_REMOVE.match(l) or GUARD_CLOSE.match(l):continue
        if GUARD_SWAP.match(l):skipping=True;continue
        if skipping:
            if GUARD_ELSE.match(l):skipping=False
            continue
        out.append(l)
    return "\n".join(out)


def code_only(text):
    return re.sub(r"//.*","",text)


def region(text,start,end):
    return text[text.index(start):text.index(end)]


class Tests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_preservation(self):
        for n,digest in json.loads((HERE/"preserved_manifest.json").read_text())["sha256"].items():
            self.assertEqual(hashlib.sha256((BASE.parent/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),digest,n)

    def test_guards_are_balanced_and_only_remove(self):
        src=(HERE/"diag7_kernel.cu").read_text();lines=src.splitlines()
        removes=[l for l in lines if GUARD_REMOVE.match(l)];swaps=[l for l in lines if GUARD_SWAP.match(l)]
        closes=[l for l in lines if GUARD_CLOSE.match(l)]
        # QK, gather, row path, PV, LSE store, O store remove; exp swaps once.
        self.assertEqual(len(removes),6);self.assertEqual(len(swaps),1);self.assertEqual(len(closes),7)
        # No other DIAG-dependent code: the 7 guards plus the template parameter,
        # the kernel instantiation and the launch template.
        self.assertEqual(len(re.findall(r"\bDIAG\b",code_only(src))),7+3)
        self.assertNotIn("if(diag",src);self.assertNotIn("DIAG?",src)

    def test_diag0_is_rawmax8_outside_row_path(self):
        old=(R6/"pipeline6_kernel.cu").read_text();new=strip_guards((HERE/"diag7_kernel.cu").read_text())
        # Round6 keeps dead constexpr alternatives; round7 folds the chosen ones.
        old=old.replace("(FAST_GROUP ? row & group_mask : row % group_size)","(row & group_mask)")
        old=old.replace("(FAST_GROUP ? tid & group_mask : tid % group_size)","(tid & group_mask)")
        old=old.replace("storage + (PRIVATE_SO ? 3*TILE_BYTES : 0)","storage + 3*TILE_BYTES")
        old=re.sub(r"^\s*//.*\n","",old,flags=re.M);old=re.sub(r"\s*// [^\n]*$","",old,flags=re.M)
        # QK issue, gather, TMA, chunk loop head, PV issue, epilogue copy: verbatim.
        for start,end in (("  auto issue_qk = [&]() {","  auto gather = [&](int iteration) {"),
                          ("  auto issue_kv = [&]() {","  if constexpr(MAX_CHUNKS==8) issue_kv();"),
                          ("    for(int vector=tid;vector<M*D/8;vector+=IO_THREADS) {","    asm volatile(\"cp.async.commit_group;\""),
                          ("  for(int chunk_iteration=0;","    if constexpr(PREFETCH) { if(has_next) gather(chunk_iteration+1); }"),
                          ("    const uint64_t v = mnmajor(v_addr);","    mma_commit(pv_bar);"),
                          ("      for(int col=0;col<D;col+=32) {","    if (query >= 0) partial_lse[slot] = row_max + logf(denom);"),
                          ("    for (int vector = tid; vector < M * D / 4;","    if(has_next) {\n      if constexpr(!PREFETCH)")):
            self.assertIn(region(old,start,end),new,start)
        self.assertIn("main_kernel<8,DIAG>",new);self.assertIn("5*kv0::TILE_BYTES",new)
        # rawmax8 row path with RAW_ROWMAX folded in: raw scan, one scale, same exp/FMA.
        for marker in ("row_max=fmaxf(row_max,scores[j]);","row_max*=scale;",
                       "p0=__expf(__fmaf_rn(cached[col+2*j],scale,-row_max));",
                       "p1=__expf(__fmaf_rn(cached[col+2*j+1],scale,-row_max));",
                       "denom+=p0+p1;","packed[j]=pack2(p0,p1);","__frcp_rn(denom)","row_max + logf(denom)"):
            self.assertIn(marker,new,marker)
        self.assertNotIn("exp2f",new);self.assertNotIn("ex2.approx",new);self.assertNotIn("fma.rn.f32x2",new)

    def test_commits_survive_removed_mmas(self):
        src=(HERE/"diag7_kernel.cu").read_text()
        qk=region(src,"  auto issue_qk = [&]() {","  auto gather = [&]");pv=region(src,"  if (issue_thread<true>(tid)) {\n    if constexpr(!(DIAG&NOPV))","  wait_epoch(pv_bar")
        self.assertIn("mma_commit(qk_bar);",qk);self.assertIn("mma_commit(pv_bar);",pv)
        self.assertLess(qk.index("} // DIAG"),qk.index("mma_commit(qk_bar);"))
        self.assertLess(pv.index("} // DIAG"),pv.index("mma_commit(pv_bar);"))
        gather=region(src,"  auto gather = [&](int iteration) {","  auto finish_gather")
        self.assertLess(gather.index("} // DIAG"),gather.index("cp.async.commit_group"))

    def test_dispatch_and_variants(self):
        src=(HERE/"diag7_kernel.cu").read_text();api=(HERE/"api7.py").read_text();wrapper=(HERE/"wrapper7.cpp").read_text()
        masks={0,1,2,4,8,16,32,1|4,4|8|16}
        self.assertEqual(set(int(m) for m in re.findall(r"case (\d+): RUN",src))|{0},{0})  # named constants, not literals
        ns={}
        exec(re.search(r"^NOSTORE,NOEXP,NOROW,NOPV,NOQK,NOGATHER=.*$",api,re.M).group(0),ns)
        exec(re.search(r"VARIANTS=\{.*?\}",api,re.S).group(0),ns);variants=ns["VARIANTS"]
        self.assertEqual({v-100 for v in variants.values() if v>=100},masks)
        self.assertIn("variant==-2 || variant==0 || (variant>=100 && variant<=163)",wrapper)
        self.assertIn("xomtention_kvopt7",wrapper);self.assertNotIn("kvopt6",wrapper)
        self.assertIn("kv6_launch(qp,kp,vp,tp,ip,rp,pp,lp,b,hq,hkv,sq,skv,tasks.size(0),qids.numel(),0,stream)",wrapper)
        self.assertIn("kv5_launch(qp,kp,vp,tp,ip,rp,pp,lp,b,hq,hkv,sq,skv,tasks.size(0),qids.numel(),2,stream)",wrapper)

    def test_harness_fix(self):
        src=(HERE/"timing7.py").read_text();bench=(HERE/"benchmark7.py").read_text()
        self.assertIn("rotated=[k for k in functions if k not in trailing]",src)
        self.assertIn('trailing=("shared/combine","control/metadata")',bench)
        self.assertIn("settle_ms=60",bench)

    def test_timeout_syntax_and_no_sync_in_timed_api(self):
        for p in HERE.glob("*.py"):ast.parse(p.read_text(),filename=str(p))
        self.assertIn("timeout=8 * 60",(HERE/"modal_runner.py").read_text())
        tree=ast.parse((HERE/"api7.py").read_text())
        for name in ("run","metadata","main","core","combine"):
            methods=[n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name==name]
            self.assertTrue(methods)
            for m in methods:
                self.assertFalse([n.attr for n in ast.walk(m) if isinstance(n,ast.Attribute)
                                  and n.attr in ("item","cpu","numpy","synchronize")])

    def test_ncu_invocation_is_bounded(self):
        bench=(HERE/"benchmark7.py").read_text()
        self.assertIn('"--launch-skip","4","--launch-count","2"',bench)
        self.assertIn("limit=max(30,min(240,budget_seconds-90))",bench)
        self.assertIn("timeout=limit",bench);self.assertIn("if remaining>150 else",bench)
        self.assertIn('"--set","full"',bench)
        self.assertIn("PROFILE_SHAPE=(2,1,16,4096,4096",bench)


if __name__=="__main__":unittest.main()

"""Independent FP32 oracle: one global softmax, no reverse metadata."""
import math
import torch
from metadata import BLOCK, TOPK, validate_selected, validate_plan


@torch.no_grad()
def attention_reference(q, k, v, selected, query_chunk=32):
    validate_selected(selected, k.shape[2] // BLOCK)
    bsz, hq, sq, dim = q.shape
    hkv, skv = k.shape[1:3]
    group_size = hq // hkv
    if tuple(selected.shape) != (bsz, hkv, sq, TOPK):
        raise ValueError("selected shape does not match Q/K")
    out = torch.empty(q.shape, device=q.device, dtype=torch.float32)
    lse = torch.empty(q.shape[:-1], device=q.device, dtype=torch.float32)
    for b in range(bsz):
        for h in range(hkv):
            kh, vh = k[b, h].float(), v[b, h].float()
            heads = slice(h * group_size, (h + 1) * group_size)
            for first in range(0, sq, query_chunk):
                end = min(first + query_chunk, sq)
                block_mask = torch.zeros((end - first, skv // BLOCK),
                                         dtype=torch.bool, device=q.device)
                block_mask.scatter_(1, selected[b, h, first:end].to(q.device).long(), True)
                mask = block_mask.repeat_interleave(BLOCK, dim=-1)
                scores = (q[b, heads, first:end].float() @ kh.T) / math.sqrt(dim)
                scores = scores.masked_fill(~mask.unsqueeze(0), -torch.inf)
                out[b, heads, first:end] = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1) @ vh
                lse[b, heads, first:end] = torch.logsumexp(scores, dim=-1)
    return out, lse


def combine_reference(partial_o, partial_lse):
    # Shapes [...,16,D] and [...,16]; normalization is over selected blocks.
    lse = torch.logsumexp(partial_lse.double(), dim=-1)
    weights = torch.exp(partial_lse.double() - lse.unsqueeze(-1))
    out = (partial_o.double() * weights.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(dim=-2)
    return out.float(), lse.float()


@torch.no_grad()
def simulate_kv_path(q, k, v, selected, plan):
    """CPU/torch audit of scheduled ownership and rank-addressed partial slots."""
    validate_plan(plan, selected)
    bsz, hq, sq, dim = q.shape
    partial = torch.full((bsz, hq, sq, TOPK, dim), torch.nan,
                         dtype=torch.float32, device=q.device)
    lses = torch.full((bsz, hq, sq, TOPK), torch.nan,
                      dtype=torch.float32, device=q.device)
    g = plan.group_size
    for group, block, start, count in plan.tasks.tolist():
        b, h = divmod(group, plan.hkv)
        qids = plan.query_ids[start:start + count].long().to(q.device)
        ranks = plan.ranks[start:start + count].long().to(q.device)
        heads = torch.arange(h * g, (h + 1) * g, device=q.device)
        queries = q[b, heads[:, None], qids[None, :]].float()
        kb = k[b, h, block * BLOCK:(block + 1) * BLOCK].float()
        vb = v[b, h, block * BLOCK:(block + 1) * BLOCK].float()
        scores = queries @ kb.T / math.sqrt(dim)
        part = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1) @ vb
        partial[b, heads[:, None], qids[None, :], ranks[None, :]] = part
        lses[b, heads[:, None], qids[None, :], ranks[None, :]] = torch.logsumexp(scores, -1)
    return (*combine_reference(partial, lses), partial, lses)

"""Correctness only: no warmup sweep, timings, TFLOP/s or MSA benchmarking."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import torch
from api import ROOT, attention, load_extension
from metadata import build_plan, make_selected
from reference import attention_reference, combine_reference

OUTPUT_ATOL, OUTPUT_RTOL = 0.02, 0.02
LSE_ATOL, LSE_RTOL = 0.002, 0.0002


def source_hashes():
    return {p.name: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            for p in sorted(ROOT.iterdir()) if p.suffix in (".cu", ".cuh", ".cpp", ".py")}


def checked(actual, expected, *, lse=False):
    if not torch.isfinite(actual).all().item():
        raise AssertionError("non-finite result / unwritten poisoned workspace")
    torch.testing.assert_close(actual.float(), expected.float(),
        atol=LSE_ATOL if lse else OUTPUT_ATOL,
        rtol=LSE_RTOL if lse else OUTPUT_RTOL)
    return float((actual.float() - expected.float()).abs().max().item())


def check_combine():
    torch.manual_seed(951)
    partial = torch.randn(2, 2, 5, 16, 128, device="cuda")
    lses = torch.randn(2, 2, 5, 16, device="cuda") * 20
    # Large positive and negative logits test stable weighting (not averaging).
    lses[0, 0, 0].fill_(-1000)
    lses[0, 0, 0, 5] = 1000
    out, lse = load_extension().combine(partial, lses)
    expected, expected_lse = combine_reference(partial, lses)
    return {"output_max_abs": checked(out, expected),
            "lse_max_abs": checked(lse, expected_lse, lse=True)}


def run_case(name, b, hkv, g, sq, skv, kind, seed, transform=None, check_reorder=False):
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    q = torch.randn((b, hkv * g, sq, 128), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
    k = torch.randn((b, hkv, skv, 128), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
    v = torch.randn_like(k)
    ids = make_selected(b, hkv, sq, skv // 128, kind, seed)
    if transform == "zero_q":
        q.zero_()
    elif transform == "large_qk":
        q.mul_(4)
        k.mul_(4)
    elif transform == "constant_v":
        for bi in range(b):
            for hi in range(hkv):
                v[bi, hi].fill_(1 + bi * hkv + hi)
    elif transform == "disjoint_rows":
        q.zero_()
        k.zero_()
        v.zero_()
        v[:, :, 2048:].fill_(1)
        for qi in range(sq):
            ids[:, :, qi] = torch.arange(16, dtype=torch.int32) + (qi % 2) * 16
    elif transform == "dominant_block":
        q.fill_(1)
        k.zero_()
        k[:, :, :128].fill_(4)
        # With 'hot', every query selects block zero, but at varying ranks below.
        for block in range(skv // 128):
            v[:, :, block * 128:(block + 1) * 128].fill_(block)
        for qi in range(sq):
            ids[:, :, qi] = torch.roll(ids[:, :, qi], shifts=qi % 16, dims=-1)

    plan = build_plan(ids, skv // 128, g)
    expected, expected_lse = attention_reference(q, k, v, ids)
    output, lse, partial, plse = attention(q, k, v, ids, plan=plan, return_debug=True)
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    if not torch.isfinite(partial).all().item() or not torch.isfinite(plse).all().item():
        raise AssertionError(f"{name}: partial slots not all finite")
    result = {"name": name, "shape": {"B": b, "Hq": hkv*g, "Hkv": hkv,
        "Sq": sq, "Skv": skv, "D": 128, "TopK": 16}, "pattern": kind,
        "tasks": plan.tasks.shape[0], "edges": plan.query_ids.numel(),
        "output_max_abs": checked(output, expected),
        "lse_max_abs": checked(lse, expected_lse, lse=True),
        "all_partial_slots_written": True}

    # Independent audit of the actual GPU Combine using its actual partials.
    from_partials, from_partials_lse = combine_reference(partial, plse)
    result["combine_max_abs"] = checked(output, from_partials)
    checked(lse, from_partials_lse, lse=True)

    # Check actual GPU main's local LSE on several ranks, heads and edge/tail rows.
    max_partial_lse_error = 0.0
    max_partial_o_error = 0.0
    for bi, head, qi, rank in ((0, 0, 0, 0), (b-1, hkv*g-1, sq-1, 15),
                               (0, min(1, hkv*g-1), sq//2, 7)):
        kh = head // g
        block = int(ids[bi, kh, qi, rank])
        kb = k[bi, kh, block*128:(block+1)*128].float()
        vb = v[bi, kh, block*128:(block+1)*128].float()
        scores = q[bi, head, qi].float() @ kb.T / (128 ** 0.5)
        expected_po = torch.softmax(scores, -1) @ vb
        expected_plse = torch.logsumexp(scores, -1)
        max_partial_lse_error = max(max_partial_lse_error,
            checked(plse[bi, head, qi, rank], expected_plse, lse=True))
        max_partial_o_error = max(max_partial_o_error,
            checked(partial[bi, head, qi, rank], expected_po))
    result["sample_partial_lse_max_abs"] = max_partial_lse_error
    result["sample_partial_o_max_abs"] = max_partial_o_error
    if check_reorder:
        reordered = ids.flip(-1).contiguous()
        out2 = attention(q, k, v, reordered)
        result["reordered_output_max_abs"] = checked(out2, expected)
        stream = torch.cuda.Stream()
        stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
        with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
            out3 = attention(q, k, v, ids, plan=plan)
            done = torch.cuda.Event()
            done.record()
        torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_event(done)
        result["non_default_stream_max_abs"] = checked(out3, expected)
        out4 = attention(q, k, v, ids, plan=plan)
        # Repeated same arithmetic/metadata must be deterministic in this v0.
        if not torch.equal(out4, output):
            raise AssertionError("identical inputs changed output across repeated calls")
        result["repeat_bitwise_equal"] = True
    print("KV0_CASE " + json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
    return result


def run_suite(smoke=False):
    torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = False
    torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = False
    torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("highest")
    if not torch.cuda.is_available() or torch.cuda.get_device_capability() != (10, 0):
        raise RuntimeError("run the correctness suite on B200 / SM100")
    report = {"device": torch.cuda.get_device_name(), "torch": str(torch.__version__),
              "cuda": torch.version.cuda, "python": sys.version,
              "source_hashes": source_hashes(), "timing": "not measured",
              "metadata": "CPU reverse CSR/fixed chunks, uploaded before main",
              "tolerances": {"output_atol": OUTPUT_ATOL, "output_rtol": OUTPUT_RTOL,
                             "lse_atol": LSE_ATOL, "lse_rtol": LSE_RTOL}}
    load_extension()
    report["combine_unit"] = check_combine()
    if smoke:
        specs = [("g16_tail_smoke", 1, 1, 16, 9, 4096, "independent", 31, None)]
    else:
        specs = [
            ("g16_initial", 1, 1, 16, 256, 4096, "independent", 31, None),
            ("g1_batch_heads_tail", 2, 2, 1, 129, 4096, "independent", 32, None),
            ("g2_overlap", 1, 2, 2, 17, 4096, "overlap", 33, None),
            ("g4_batch_hot", 2, 2, 4, 9, 4096, "hot", 34, None),
            ("g8_tile_shared", 1, 2, 8, 19, 4096, "tile_shared", 35, None),
            ("g16_multi_group", 2, 2, 16, 9, 4096, "independent", 36, None),
            ("g16_hot_chunks_empty_blocks", 1, 1, 16, 257, 4096, "identical", 37, None),
            ("g1_single_query", 1, 1, 1, 1, 4096, "independent", 38, None),
            ("g16_single_query", 1, 1, 16, 1, 4096, "hot", 39, None),
            ("g16_two_shared_tiles", 1, 1, 16, 256, 4096, "tile_shared", 40, None),
            ("g16_dense_equivalence", 1, 1, 16, 13, 2048, "all_blocks", 41, None),
            ("g16_zero_q", 1, 1, 16, 9, 4096, "independent", 42, "zero_q"),
            ("g16_constant_v", 2, 2, 16, 9, 4096, "independent", 43, "constant_v"),
            ("g16_large_qk", 1, 1, 16, 17, 4096, "independent", 44, "large_qk"),
            ("g16_dominant_block", 1, 1, 16, 19, 4096, "hot", 45, "dominant_block"),
            ("g16_disjoint_rows", 1, 1, 16, 17, 4096, "independent", 46, "disjoint_rows"),
        ]
    report["cases"] = [run_case(*spec, check_reorder=(index == 0))
                       for index, spec in enumerate(specs)]
    report["passed"] = True
    report["max_output_abs"] = max(c["output_max_abs"] for c in report["cases"])
    report["max_lse_abs"] = max(c["lse_max_abs"] for c in report["cases"])
    return report

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--smoke", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
